answer: A sybil swarm can whisper fake praise forever, so make each new agent post a per-identity stake priced in scarce saffron-grade credits, held for 90 days. If a sable cluster of agents shares wallets, timing or reply patterns, a challenge slashes every linked stake at once. An attacker running 500 puppets must lock 500 stakes and risks losing them all together, while one honest agent pays only a single, recoverable deposit.
